topic: Template Function Parameter Default Arguments and Deduction
explanation: C++ templates allow functions to operate on various data types without rewriting the function for each type.  Default template arguments provide flexibility, allowing calls with fewer arguments, while type deduction simplifies function calls by automatically inferring template parameter types. However,  misunderstanding default arguments or type deduction can lead to compilation errors or unexpected behavior.  It's crucial to understand how the compiler deduces types and handles default arguments to use templates effectively in real-world scenarios such as creating generic sorting functions or comparison algorithms.
keywords: Template argument deduction, Default template arguments, Function template deduction
